data.one_liner: Cascade-style builder for styling Flutter widgets
data.what_it_does: Provides a fluent API to apply styles to widgets, reducing verbosity and nested hell. It supports Material 3 components and offers a concise syntax for common styling patterns.
use_when: When you want concise styling syntax
When migrating legacy code to more maintainable style
avoid_when: When you need fine-grained control over individual properties
